This page is under construction.

The ND-HNC provides hardware and infrastructure to support research activities. Please see below for detailed instructions on how to use these resources:

| Resource | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| [CorpFS](operate/corpfs.qmd) | Centralize experiment protocols and participant response data. |
| [MRI Simulator](operate/mock.qmd) | Prepare participants to contribute MRI data. |
| [NNL SyncBox](operate/nnl_syncbox.qmd) | Capture fMRI synchronization pulse and participant responses. |
| [MRI](operate/mri.qmd) | Scan a participant. |
| NordicNeuroLab | Deploy functional MRI paradigms and capture participant responses. |
| Stimulus Control | Deploy lab-specific MRI paradigms. |
| [DICOM Management](operate/dcm_computer.qmd) | Capture, organize, and send DICOM files to an appropriate location. |
